announcements.title: StegZ 1.3 is here
announcements.message:
• Text & code editor with colour highlighting (select a file, press Edit)
• Preview pictures and text inside archives without extracting
• Archives now open and list instantly
• Faster update checks
Tip: press F1 for the Help guide.

announcements.title: StegZ for Android 1.3
announcements.message:
• Real file-manager engine: folders open instantly
• File access is now checked live - the app locks until access is allowed
• Save and extract into any folder on your phone
• Text & code editor with colours
• Preview files inside archives without extracting
• Safer buttons, pull-to-refresh and faster lists
Made by Havenova X - havenovax.name.ng
